annotations.text:
Three directions for the SAME screen — home.

The premise each is trying to express: you follow SUBJECTS, not people, so a person-follow never widens your feed. The last attempt collapsed that into one blended stream with a rail on top, which is why it read as Instagram with a colour swap.

A · FIELD ALMANAC
The feed IS your interests, listed as sections — never blended. Editorial: serif, hairlines, media as inset plates, mono for meta. Says the subject matters more than who posted.

Trade: type-led, so it reads slower and shows less media per screen.

B · THE INDEX
Makes the machinery visible — the header literally states the feed is composed from five interests, with live counts. Dense, numbered, Swiss. Feels like an instrument.

Trade: cold, and the least media-forward of the three.

C · ROOMS
An interest is a place with its own light. Home is a threshold, not a stream: each room sized by how alive it is. Colour and atmosphere carry identity.

Trade: the most colour-dependent, and it defers the content one tap.
